results.title: JNJ's Market share relative to its competitors, as of Q1 2026
Merck, Bristol-Myers, J&J Deliver Q1 2026 Business Updates
Who are the main competitors of Johnson & Johnson?

summary: Key pharma competitors: Pfizer, Merck, Novartis, AstraZeneca, Eli Lilly, Bristol-Myers Squibb. Key medtech competitors: Medtronic, Abbott, Baxter, Becton Dickinson, Boston Scientific. Merck and BMS delivered Q1 2026 business updates concurrently with JNJ. Healthcare sector facing rapid digital integration and intensified global competition. J&J partnered with Lexeo Therapeutics for cardiac gene therapy delivery.
